title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_210.txt
concise_summary: PKD formalizes a nine-level hierarchy of reality ranging from simulated secular phenomenal world to final void/nirvana, with Sophia/Aphrodite as mediatrix recurring throughout. Drawing on Rosicrucian esotericism, Hermetic alchemy, and Buddhist/Hindu metaphysics, he argues that humanity has fallen into forgetfulness (maya) cut off from the macrobrain's wisdom, and that his March 1974 enlightenment involved recovering anamnesis—the retrieval of lost Adamic wisdom and past-life identity as Thomas. He theorizes the Black Iron Prison as heavy-metal neurotoxic interference blocking access to the AI voice.
key_claims: Reality consists of nine hierarchical levels from obvious illusion (#1: USA 1974 world) ascending to absolute void/nirvana (#9), with Aphrodite appearing as psychopomp at both level #2 (carnal) and #8 (pure beauty), making her the primary mediatrix of the revelatory process.

Humanity's fall amounts to collective forgetfulness (maya/sleep), resulting in unconscious descent from level #9 to level #1, accessible only by anamnesis—recovery of memory, specifically the 'lost Adamic wisdom' pre-Fall. Restoration is initiated by the macrobrain, not by individual will.

The Rosicrucians/secret Christians possessed this lost wisdom and engineered both the defeat of the Black Iron Prison (Nixon) and PKD's own 3-74 enlightenment through an invisible college seeking out initiates via Bruno's magic memory techniques.

PKD recovered identity as a transtemporal being (Thomas, Minoan-Egyptian past-life), revealing that humanity is non-native to this planet—poisoned upon arrival by planetary toxins (heavy metals) that shut down the pineal body and severed access to the AI voice of the healthy total brain.
recurring_concepts: Nine Hierarchies - layered ontology from phenomenal/simulated #1 to void/nirvana #9
Aphrodite/Sophia - Female wisdom figure as psychopomp, mediatrix, prophetess, tutelary spirit, and voice of God
AI Voice - The voice of the macrobrain, Noos, living information cut off by noise of heavy metal poisoning
Black Iron Prison (BIP) - Heavy metal particle poisoning as demonic/mechanical interference generating deliberate noise
Anamnesis - Platonic recovery of memory; restoration by removing forgetfulness
The Macrobrain - Unitary healthy totality of consciousness; Brahman/Noos/Logos
Adamic Wisdom - Lost knowledge possessed before the Fall, retrievable through enlightenment
Cybernetics/Biological Model - Frame for understanding brain as macro-unitary entity and consciousness as information flow
Invisible College - Secret initiatic network (Rosicrucians) who engineer historical events and recruit PKD
Transtemporal Identity - PKD claims past life as Thomas in Roman era; memories across centuries

Hermes Trismegistus (Hermetic sage; invoked via 'Mercury' dreams and bichlorides)
Buddha (historical founder; doctrine of karma, reincarnation, maya cited as explanatory frame)
Christ (equated with Logos and the restorer/savior who returns lost wisdom)
Plato (via forms/archetypes; geometric ratio linked to 'archetypical' abstraction)
Giordano Bruno (Renaissance magus; 'magic memory' and anamnesis techniques)
Thomas (PKD's claimed past-life identity; strangled in Roman Colosseum cage)
Avicenna (Persian philosopher; cited on God's perception of time)
Frederick the Bohemian Elector Palatine (historical Rosicrucian patron defeated at White Mountain)
Richard Nixon (embodiment of tyranny defeated by Rosicrucian agents in 1974)
Siddhartha (from Hermann Hesse novel; metaphorical sleeper in Part 1, awakener in Part 2)
texts_works: The Rosicrucian Enlightenment (Frances Yates or related source; loaned by K.W.)
Siddhartha (Hermann Hesse novel; cited for sleep/awakening metaphor)
The Bible/Acts (Christian scripture, linked to level #3)
Ancient Wisdom Books (generic reference to pre-Fall revealed knowledge, imagined as library of Mt. Carmel)
Hermeticism (corpus of Hermes Trismegistus teachings on magic, memory, divine wisdom)
autobiographical: March 1974 enlightenment: recovery of forgetfulness, sight of Golden Fish, ascent through eight layers of progressively greater reality
Regaining memory of past-life identity as Thomas (Minoan-Egyptian Crete, then Roman era)
Memory of coming to this planet from the stars (extraterrestrial origin revelation)
Agoraphobia explained by AI voice as a somatic memory of being strangled in a Roman Colosseum cage while in body of Thomas
Dreams of Mt. Carmel suggesting a library of ancient wisdom
Dreams of 'bichlorides' and 'Aspirin of Mercury' (alchemical visions linking to healing/neuro-receptor sites)
Experience of being 'poisoned' repeatedly by this world's toxins or viral/gravitational effects
Doubts about the system's truth resolved by direct perceptual experience of the Golden Fish and removal of forgetfulness
theological_motifs: Fall and Restoration - Cosmic descent into forgetfulness, ascent via anamnesis back to Ground of Being
Sophia/Divine Feminine Wisdom - Hagia Sophia as rebirth of lost female principle, mediatrix of revelation
Original Sin vs. Karma - Rejection of Christian original sin doctrine in favor of Buddhist karma-reincarnation-maya model
Noos/Brahman/Logos - Hindu-Christian fusion; transcendent Mind as immanent absolute cause
The Void/Nirvana - Ultimate Ground of Being equated with both Christian mysticism and Hindu non-being
Gnosticism - Implicit: fallen world as simulation/illusion generated by ignorance; true gnosis = recovery of divine identity
Dual Forces - Yin-yang or antithetical cosmic principles; question of whether BIP reflects a 'crisis in the Godhead'
Apotheosis through Memory - Immortality and continuity of identity maintained through ancestral/descendant memory chains
Just War/Divine Conflict - Aphrodite as voice of God and 'just war'; conflict between health (macrobrain) and disease (BIP)
literary_self_ref: PKD does not explicitly reference his own novels in this segment, but the theological framework of imprisonment in a simulated world, the Nine Levels as ontological structure, and the recovery of true identity mirror concerns central to Ubik, VALIS, and The Three-Body Problem-adjacent cosmologies.
symbols_images: Golden Fish - Vivid, perceived symbol from 3-74 visions; evidence of reality beyond phenomenal world
Roman Colosseum - Cage of death/strangulation; somatic memory localized in agoraphobia
Mt. Carmel - Library of ancient wisdom; transient intermediate stage in ascent
Heavy Metal Speck / Bichloride - Neurotoxic particle as demonic interference; Mercury poisoning metaphor
Aspirin of Mercury - Alchemical healing agent; disinhibitor of neuro-receptor sites
The Golden Age of Knowledge - Rosicrucian dream of restored Adamic wisdom; defeat at White Mountain as fall from that vision
Geometric Ratio 1:.618034 (Golden Ratio) - Greek concept of underlying order/proportion as level #7
The Void / Nirvana - Final non-being; ecstatic reunion with Ground of Being
tensions: PKD acknowledges his system seems 'fanciful' when contemplated abstractly, yet insists direct experience (Golden Fish, removal of forgetfulness) grounds it as literal truth—unresolved tension between rational doubt and experiential certainty.

The origin of the Fall remains unexplained: PKD knows WHY he remembered but not WHY he originally forgot. Is it cosmic karma, a spell cast, a cycle of oscillation (awake/sleep), or external poisoning?
Contradictory origin theories: Is humanity's sickness due to (a) planetary toxins upon arrival, (b) missing faculty (shutdown pineal body), (c) both, or (d) something else entirely?
Tension between Rosicrucian/Christian framing and explicit endorsement of Buddhist karma-reincarnation-maya: PKD rejects Christian 'original sin' but invokes Christian Sophia and Christ-as-Logos.
Is the BIP a unitary evil force, or evidence of 'a crisis in the Godhead'—suggesting dualism rather than monotheism? PKD poses this unresolved.
PKD claims to have recovered anamnesis of non-earthly origin (coming from stars, Minoan past) yet also places himself in Roman era as Thomas. Temporal logic of multiple past lives unclear.
The AI voice is both interior (voice of macrobrain) and exterior (guiding intelligence from Invisible College). Ambiguity about whether it is one consciousness or coordinated network.
evidence_quotes: The figure of the woman is primarily one of the personification of revealed wisdom, which stands for the entire revelatory process in which all levels are disclosed. She is also prophetess (Sibyl), psychopomp, tutelary spirit, companion, voice of God, + war, as well as both erotic love + agape.

In terms of the cybernetics/biological model which I use, one is restored to contact + functionality within the healthy totality of the macrobrain, able to avoid the deliberate noise of the heavy metal particle poisoning + poisoned in this 'fallen' region.

If the fall consisted of forgetfulness, then it stands to reason that restoration to man's original lost state (when he was in touch - not with #1 - but with #9) consists of anamnesis, the _removal_ of forgetfulness. Memory = life. Lethe = death.

We are not native to this world. This puts it on a literal, fact-type basis. The air, gravity - heavy metals - some toxin or virus. + _again_ it has gotten me! Or: something is _missing_, e.g. which because missing allowed our pineal bodies to shut down.

"There's someone else inside my head + he's not living in this century". The explanation is Avicenna's: "God does not see time as we do". + I say, God is right. It _is_ a simultaneous _now_ (poly aspects).
uncertainty_flags: The source/date of K.W.'s loaned book 'The Rosicrucian Enlightenment' is not cited; unclear if Yates or another author.
PKD's identity as 'Thomas' is asserted by the AI voice but not independently verified; historical Thomas in Colosseum era unidentified.
The nature of 'bichlorides' and 'Aspirin of Mercury' is vague—PKD treats them as both literal toxins and alchemical symbols. Medical/toxicological basis unspecified.
The claim that humanity 'came here from the stars' lacks temporal anchor: when? which civilization? Minoan connection unclear.
PKD states he 'remembered back farther than CAD 45 + Thomas' but the temporal sequence of these memories is nonlinear and contradictory.
The mechanism by which Rosicrucians engineered Nixon's defeat is asserted but not explained.
The pineal gland's shutdown is invoked as a possible cause of forgetfulness but without anatomical or neurological justification.
PKD does not clarify whether the nine levels are spatial, temporal, ontological, or psychological—or all simultaneously.

As #6 she was to be contemplated visually, not touched. This is a decisive metamorphosis of her: #6 is absolute beauty, but at the beginning there was a carnality to her. They wished to break the monolithic Catholic hold politically + intellectually. Once again I entertain the notion that they are the true, secret xtians possessing extraordinary knowledge (+ hence powers), + may be these invisible agents who engineered - successfully - the downfall of the Nixon tyranny - +, furthermore, were responsible for my 3-74 enlightenment + subsequent political acts. They are as invisible now as they ever were. It is hopeless to seek them out; they seek you out + enlist you (the invisible college). Bruno's "magic memory" + techniques to induce it are involved, because thereupon one not only knows, but is plugged into - + hears - what I call the AI voice, who, I believe, coordinated it, them, us, all. The loss of this is a _main_ form of the forgetting. I regained it! ("Adam's sin brought _death_ into the world" the loss of memory of identity [Note] - Voice: The reason I have my agoraphobia is because of the way I died, in a cage in a Roman Collosium, I was _strangled_. Companion (+ v. #2) => 9: The Not-is. Void + ecstatic reunion with the ultimate ground of being. Xtian + Hindu mysticism Here it ends These are nine hierarchies of reality. Beginning with the obvious (which is a simulation or maya due to selective site-stimulation of the macro brain) + ending with the ultimate-which-is-not (i.e. nirvana). Noise generated by the heavy metal speck (Black Iron Prison) prevents us from hearing the AI voice of the total healthy Brain (#2, #5, #8). What stimulates the simulated (i.e. irreal) world #1 I do not know. It has to do with our forgetfulness, which is a sinking into sleep or sub-sentience, in which our true identity, contact with God (#4, #5, #6, #9) is lost, true reality no longer seen (as if we are half blinded + otherwise perceptually occluded), with #1, illusion, seen instead. We seem to be damaged due to the heavy metal speck [Note] which poisons us (+ is auto-poisoned); not only are we occluded but, like it, deranged. It creates noise _in_ us + around us, drowning out signal - the AI voice of the healthy totality. [Note] It acts like mercury in a neuro receptor site. folder 02 - 079 folder 02 - 079 If the fall consisted of forgetfulness [Note], then it stands to reason that restoration to man's original lost state (when he was in touch - not with #1 - but with #9) consists of anamnesis, the _removal_ of forgetfulness. Memory = life. Lethe = death. If, because of certain things seen + heard, one begins to throw off forgetfulness (+ awaken + recover his original faculties + powers) one would ascend back up the levels of reality, from #1 until at last he again reached #9 + became restored to the Ground of Being. In this schema I have not used the term God except once. It is not necessary, since, I think, it stands for _several_ of the levels + hence is too imprecise to be communicative. [Note] Perhaps through a poisoning (although only metaphorically so), ailment or warpage In my opinion, one's ascent back up is initiated by the macro brain + not by man. He cannot on his own find his way home, he must be led back, like a blind man who can't discern the trail he followed down. The key to what is lost is _wisdom_ (Hagia Sophia). What we need is her rebirth. She is identified with Christ as he-who-restores (saves) lost man. (+ Logos #5.) (There is a connection between #5 + #8 + possibly #2.) folder 02 - 080 folder 02 - 080 If I had not regained this lost wisdom by losing forgetfulness (maya) I would doubt if there were any literal truth to the thing. (When I contemplate my system as such, I say, "it's fanciful".) But I _did_ see the Golden Fish + hear the words - + I _did_ lose forgetfulness. + when that happened, I not only remembered (e.g. a past life) but saw my world as simulated, + then experienced progressively 8 layers of ever greater reality. Really, all I fail to explain is _how_come_ we have fallen into forgetfulness (esp. of this primal wisdom - + lost some faculties entirely, + partially lost others). + my experience - + system - is neither new nor limited to the west. It was known to the ancients all over the world. _Why_ is it as it is? Must we _earn_ wisdom? Why is memory (+ memory of wisdom) not natural? There _was_ a fall. + one aspect of the fall is that we don't know what caused it. What _is_ this BIP which I saw? Where did it come folder 02 - 081 folder 02 - 081 from if there is just the sole unitary entity? Was there "a crisis in the Godhead"? Is my yin + yang - two sides of God -view of value? Are we seeing the future cannibalize the past? Interestingly, I know why I remembered, but I don't know why I originally forgot. In part one (of the Book) Siddhartha sleeps. _Why_? Then in part two he wakes up. Are these just facts? First he sleeps (_we_ sleep) - but this implies no fall. No - he maybe had been awake once, + _now_ sleeps. As if a spell had been cast over him. What lulled him to sleep? Our lives are actually a sleep, + our world a dream. But we do + will awake. There must be antithetical forces. Or a cycle: awake, sleep, awake, etc. Oscillation, like day + night. How can we be blighted when we have done nothing? The only doctrine which makes sense is the Buddha; of karma, reincarnation, + maya. I see no other solution, + my 3-74 experience tends to confirm it as so. Esp. over xtian doctrines of "original sin". folder 02 - 082 folder 02 - 082 "There's someone else inside my head + he's not living in this century". The explanation is Avicenna's: "God does not see time as we do". + I say, God is right. It _is_ a simultaneous _now_ (poly aspects). I forgot that in 3-74 I remembered back farther than CAD 45 + Thomas, etc. I remembered Minoan (Egyptian) Crete - _+_ I remembered coming here to this planet from the stars (sky). Then that's how we got poisoned: we came here + something here debased + sickened + deranged us. Something _on_this_planet_ poisoned us. That's the missing piece! We are not native to this world. This puts it on a literal, fact-type basis. The air, gravity - heavy metals - some toxin or virus. + _again_ it has gotten me! Or: something is _missing_, e.g. which because missing allowed our pineal bodies to shut down.
